d:
Enjoy the power-packed emotions of “Duniya Dushman Bane To Bane”, a memorable song from the film Dilwaala (1986). Sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar, this song perfectly captures fearless love and unshakable determination, brought alive on screen by Mithun Chakraborty and Meenakshi Seshadri.
Duniya Dushman Bane To Bane | Kishore Kumar | Dilwaala 1986 | Mithun Chakraborty, Meenakshi Seshadri
Song : Duniya Dushman Bane To Bane
Movie : Dilwaala (1986)
Star Cast : Mithun Chakraborty, Meenakshi Seshadri
Singer : Kishore Kumar
Music Director : Bappi Lahiri
Lyricist : Indeevar
